svg.title: The Bias Draft · v3-math-desktop-1200.svg
svg.desc: Bias-cut pattern draft (Route I before II). Panel I (The Architecture of Control) renders 39 of 39 D3-displaced carriers; Panel II (Wearable 7-Node Kinematic Drone Interface) renders 39 of 39 phi-quasiperiodic counter-bias carriers. Signed seam x_s(y) = x_0 + 1.15a(T - Q) with 6 bounded interference blooms. Synthetic optical gradient condition 3.38 (formal geometry, not empirical identifiability). Eight unadjudicated human gates basted; human closure reserved.
